description: Permissions for the account webviews that load WhatsApp Web, Telegram Web or Slack from the remote origin. Deliberately minimal: third-party code runs in these webviews, so the only things granted are the command the injected bootstrap script reports through, the unread-count command Telegram Web calls on its own, and the link opener Telegram Web calls when a message link is clicked. The opener is restricted to web schemes by `plugins.shell.open` in tauri.conf.json; it is granted to every account origin because the shell plugin installs its link handler in all of them, and a scheme the scope rejects would be a dead click rather than a fallback.
